name: Shelly Dimmer Gen3 (EU)

radios.note: Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n and Bluetooth (KB lists a Bluetooth ID).

matter.note: Shelly says Gen3 devices did not ship with Matter and not all will get it; its Matter firmware notes name relays, not this dimmer. A certificate ID was seen in passing but no CSA listing for this dimmer surfaced, so unconfirmed.

apple_home.note: No Matter certification confirmed and no Shelly page names Apple Home for this model.

google_home.note: Shelly's spec table marks Google Smart Home traits as supported.

alexa.note: Shelly's spec table marks Amazon Alexa capabilities as supported.

smartthings.note: Shelly's spec table marks Samsung SmartThings capabilities as supported.

home_assistant.note: Official Shelly integration with local push.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device with its own access point and web interface.

localControl.note: Built-in web interface works without internet or Shelly Cloud; Home Assistant's Shelly integration uses local push.

switchForm.note: Compact dimming controller that sits behind an existing wall switch.

dimmer.note: Trailing-edge dimmer for dimmable LED, incandescent and halogen loads.

neutralRequired.note: Works with or without neutral. Without neutral and without a Bypass the minimum load is 20 W.

summary: Shelly Dimmer Gen3 is a single-channel trailing-edge dimmer module, max 200 W, that goes in the box behind an existing wall switch. It runs on Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, works with or without a neutral wire, and has a local web interface that needs no cloud. Shelly lists Google, Alexa and SmartThings support, Home Assistant has an official integration, and Apple Home is not confirmed.
caveats: Without a neutral wire and without Shelly's Bypass, the minimum load is 20 W.
No Matter certification is confirmed for this model, so Apple Home support is unconfirmed.
